body:
2026年9月2日，美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新受邀参加在纽约市贾维茨会议中心（Javits Center）举行的 One New York Interfaith Summit（纽约州跨宗教信仰领袖峰会），并与纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔（Kathy Hochul）会面、合影交流。

此次峰会汇聚来自纽约州不同宗教传统及信仰团体的代表，共同围绕心理健康、家庭与社区支持、成瘾问题、食品保障以及政府与信仰社区合作等社会议题展开交流。

活动期间，吉法新会长与来自不同宗教及社会组织的信仰领袖和代表进行了友好交流，并向与会人士介绍道教文化以及美国阳翥道教协会在纽约开展宗教文化交流和社区服务等方面的工作。

吉法新会长表示，道教重视和谐、慈爱与济世利人的精神。美国阳翥道教协会愿继续加强与纽约州各信仰团体及社会各界的交流与合作，让更多人认识和了解道教，并积极参与跨宗教对话与社区建设。
body_en:
Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji, President of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America, Attends the One New York Interfaith Summit
On September 2, 2026, Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji, President of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America, was invited to attend the **One New York Interfaith Summit** at the Javits Center in New York City, where he met and took a photo with New York State Governor Kathy Hochul.

The summit brought together faith leaders and representatives from diverse religious traditions and communities across New York State. Participants engaged in discussions on important social issues, including mental health, family and community support, addiction, food security, and cooperation between government and faith communities.

During the summit, Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji engaged with faith leaders and representatives from various religious and community organizations and introduced them to Taoist culture and the work of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America in promoting religious and cultural exchange and community service in New York.

Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji emphasized that Taoism values harmony, compassion, and service to society. The Yangzhu Taoist Association of America looks forward to strengthening its relationships with faith communities and broader society across New York State, promoting greater understanding of Taoism, and continuing to participate actively in interfaith dialogue and community engagement.
